name: Jeff Yass

lean.basis: A registered Libertarian who gives almost entirely to Republicans and conservative groups: Club for Growth, Rand Paul's super PAC (2015), about $100 million to Republican groups in 2024, and $16 million to the pro-Trump MAGA Inc. in 2025. Occasional gifts to Democrats who back school choice.

current_role: Co-founder and managing director of Susquehanna International Group; Pennsylvania's richest person and a top Republican donor
summary: Jeff Yass co-founded the trading firm Susquehanna International Group (SIG) in 1987; SIG is a major investor in TikTok's parent ByteDance. He and his wife Janine fund school-choice causes and were among the largest Republican donors in 2024 and 2026. After he met Trump at a Club for Growth event in March 2024, Trump dropped his support for a TikTok ban.
